rationale: A toggle switch: a stadium track (rx = half the height) and a knob. polish.corner_radius fires because the icon rubric caps rx at 4 and the auto-fix would square the pill. Pills, capsules and stadiums are standard icon shapes (Lucide toggle-left uses rx=7); the cap should be relative (rx <= min(w,h)/2) and the clip-art veto should not apply to icons.
